text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Oh shiiiit! I was totally asleep!
I didn't take any notes at all...!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
*yawn*... Me too.
The weather's so nice today, after all.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Is this really the time to be saying that...!
Come on, Sirius, please! Let me see your notebook!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"I don't have much time until the next race...!
I can't afford to fail any tests right now!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Please—I'm begging you!!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Huh. Fine by me, I could show you.
Though, only if the compensation's right, yeah?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Well now—
Why don't you tell me something interesting?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
An interesting story, an interesting story...?
Um—ah! Like a pun!?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Then how about this! "A stone fell down! A rock-solid tumble!"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
…………
...Boring as hell.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Then how about this?
The other day, by coincidence—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: I had a chance to hear some details about the horse girls drawing attention in Europe. Aren't you curious?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Sounds interesting.
...Let's hear the details."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
――……
Very well. I'll show the both of you.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Seriously!? You did it, C.B.!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Let's see...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: —Wait, HEEEEY!!!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
What the heck is this?! It's completely blank?!
You're supposed to have good grades, so why—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Ha, 'cause there's no need to.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
You can understand most things just by reading the textbook.
So what's the point of meticulously copying it down?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Gaaahhh!
Then what was all that time for up until now~~?!

While walking down the hallway, I saw Sirius Symboli
talking with her classmates.
It was a wonderfully normal student interaction.
Watching the heartwarming scene for a short while—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Oi, what are you looking at?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Anyone would notice if you stare that hard. So.
Quite the fancy hobby you got there, peeping on me like a little puppy, huh?
choice_data_list: I was just thinking how excellent your grades are.
I didn't mean to peek, I swear...!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Haaah?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Haha, it's always like this.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Sirius's grades are insanely good, and she's pretty quiet in class.
Plus, she's an honor student.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Yeah, exactly. If you ask nicely, she'll help you study.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Ha, you guys are leaving yourselves wide open, and I can't have people looking down on me too.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
W-Who's wide open?!
Jeez, you always do this--!!

Seeing Sirius Symboli act like a normal student
felt oddly refreshing.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Still, there's no denying you were just staring on your own.
...Right?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
If you apologize, I might let it slide.
But—if you don't, what do you think's gonna happen?

What will come of it—I do not know.
However, the fact remains that it stopped me in my tracks to watch.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Sirius, are you always like this
around your Trainer too?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Haha, well-trained, aren't they?
If you want to copy it, I can teach you how.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: "I don't want it! And I don't wanna copy you!"
